description.value: Del Vecchio Pasta Fresca is a beloved Italian pasta shop and restaurant on Salt Spring Island, run by chef-owner Max Del Vecchio who moved from Italy over a decade ago. Everything is made on-site using organic local eggs and produce, traditional Italian recipes, and Italian-made equipment — from hand-rolled fresh pasta and housemade sauces to thin- and thick-crust pizzas and Sicilian cannoli. Cyclists can eat in, grab takeout, or pick up cook-at-home items for the next leg of their ride.
